name: bZx Fulcrum ETHDenver flash-loan margin trade

classification.summary: iTokens_loanOpeningFunctions.takeOrderFromiToken guarded the collateral check with a short-circuiting OR - require((loanDataBytes.length == 0 && sentAmounts[6] == sentAmounts[1]) || !OracleInterface(oracle).shouldLiquidate(...)) - so with empty loanDataBytes the left operand was true and shouldLiquidate() was never called, letting a 5x short open against the iETH pool that was instantly underwater after 5,637 ETH was swapped into 51 WBTC on Uniswap V1.

sources.note: onchain review: the exploit path is attacker contract 0x4f4e0f2cb72e718fc0433222768c57e823162152 -> iETH LoanToken 0x77f973fcaf871459aa58cd81881ce453759281bc (marginTradeFromDeposit, selector 0x1c5d1da5) -> BZxProxy 0x1cf226e9413addaf22412a2e182f9c0de44af002 (takeOrderFromiToken, selector 0xb1eac3ad), which DELEGATECALLs the iTokens_loanOpeningFunctions module 0xf0a42ec4ebb7664af5dae5c3209345d545da838a carrying the skipped shouldLiquidate check. BZxProxy was created 2019-01-28 by 0xadff3ada12ed0f8a87e31e5a04dfd2ee054e1118 (bZx deployer), unrelated to attack sender 0x148426fdc4c8a51b96b4bed827907b5fa6491ad0. BZxProxy is a per-selector module registry (mapping(bytes4 => address) targets) that emits no EIP-1967 Upgraded event, so module installs were recovered by calling targets(bytes4) under binary search over block height: targets(0xb1eac3ad) first held 0xfbc580e4f16234d5783314f1d4195971eff453f4 and was rewritten to 0xf0a42ec4 at block 9443140 (2020-02-08T16:24:12Z, tx 0x7e49e3da0817322d9a118957fd535e10ae9e19e0022181d227f01e9b7c6d3d5f from the bZx deployer via settings contract 0xbb536eb24fb89b544d4bd9e9f1f34d9fd902bb96); the other selectors the exploit drives were installed earlier (targets(0x327ab639) 2019-08-08, targets(0xb1fd9e05) 2019-12-06), so the flawed module is also the most recent install and sets the age at 6.39d rather than the 3.16y deployment figure. bZx replaced this module three days later - the same selector resolves to 0x3756fa458880fa8fe53604101cf31c542ef22f6f in the 2020-02-18 transaction. Loss not recorded in USD: the attacker took 71.4 ETH directly (6.41 ETH left in 0x4f4e0f2c plus 64.97 ETH forwarded to the EOA) and left an unrepaid Compound position worth ~1,200 ETH, the 1,271 ETH figure reported everywhere; the iETH pool's WETH balance fell from 4,858.74 to 160.72 WETH inside the transaction, leaving the undercollateralized loan behind. Order-of-magnitude sanity check only (ETH ~ $265 in Feb 2020, so ~$0.3m): far above the $1,000 floor.
loss converted at the incident timestamp (1581730737) via DefiLlama coins: 1,271 ETH x $279.72 = $355,522
